results.title: England are favourites against All Blacks, and fearless Wales are an inspiration
results.description: In his latest BBC Sport column, England World Cup winner Matt Dawson reflects on Steve Borthwick's side's emphatic 78-15 thrashing of Japan and looks ahead to their match against New Zealand next weekend.
